claims.candidate_meaning: Jinwoo said there may be a delay of unspecified object and that he did not confirm whether there was a delay, joined in one Claim with 말했으며 and 말했다고도.

atomicity.reason: The Claim joins the conjecture that a delay may exist with the separately asserted status that the checking was not done, so two independently truth-evaluable assertions are fused.

duplicates.reason: The single Claim does not restate either original assertion; no duplicate assertion layer is present.

claims.source_meaning: Jinwoo said there might be a delay and that he had not confirmed it: a conjecture (지연이 있을지도 몰라) and a separate statement that the checking was not done (확인은 못 했어), both under the reporting predicate 말했다.
